workout.session_type: DAY B - Upper (press emphasis) - FAT LOSS PHASE
workout.warmup: 10 min incline walk. Band pull-aparts x 20, arm circles, Thread-the-Needle x 8/side. RAMP THE SHOULDER PRESS: 35 lb x 8 slow, then 45 x 5. RAMP THE BENCH when you get there: 45 lb x 9, then 65 x 5. Write the ramps in and do them - every session you ramp, you hit your numbers.
workout.coach_note: Monday was a good session and everything in it moved. Squat 205 for 8/7/6 against 6/6 three days earlier - that is 21 reps at the same load versus 16, and you noted a rep still in reserve on set 3, so the clean 3x8 is right there. Hip thrust retest landed at 180 for 12 twice after 140 felt easy, so that goes to 200 next lower day. Leg extension 90 for 12. Lunges 12/11/10. And you did the 12 minute finisher, which is the part that usually gets dropped. One thing I owe you straight: Sunday you told me your hamstrings were sore and I modified the plan - leg curl down to 77 for two rounds instead of 88 for three. That change never reached you, because Chrome dropped before I could push it and the app still had the original. You ran 88 for three sets and called it fine, so no harm, and 88 is now confirmed as yours. But you trained off a plan I had already revised, and that is on my process, not your execution. I have written a rule into your file: if I cannot push a change, I give you the numbers in plain text in the chat instead of describing a session the app does not have. Today is upper. Shoulder press leads, permanently - it is the single change that has paid off most this whole program. Then bench at 80, row at 150, pulldown at 135, and the accessories run paired like Monday.
workout.finisher: 12-15 min incline walk. NOT optional this phase - you did it Monday, keep it.

exercises.name: BLOCK 1 - DB Shoulder Press (LEAD LIFT)
exercises.note: Stays first, permanently. Saturday gave 60 for 8/8/8 - the ask is to push toward 10. Three sessions have now confirmed 60, which is a weight that flatly failed you on Jul 22 when it ran second behind the bench. Upright back pad, DBs on your thighs, kick one knee at a time. RACK THE DUMBBELLS AT HIP HEIGHT - never hoisted off the floor. That rule is what two scapular strains bought.

exercises.name: BLOCK 1 - DB Bench Press
exercises.note: Saturday was your first outing with the 80s: 9, 8, 6. The drop to 6 says this is an honest working weight, not a gift - so hold 80 and close out 3x8 before adding. Controlled eccentric, do not bounce off the chest. Monitor the left shoulder; if it pinches, drop to 75 and tell me.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.note: Saturday: 135 x 12, then 150 for 10 and 10. The ask is 12s at 150. This is your pre-injury territory and it is now pain-free, which is worth noting - in September you were down at 145 and feeling the scapula. Chest up, slow, hard squeeze at the back, no yanking with the low back.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Saturday: 135 for 10, 10, 9. Close out all three at 10 and then we go to 150. Neutral or close grip if the bar is there - that is the grip you have tolerated best since the strain. Full stretch at the top, drive the elbows down.

exercises.name: BLOCK 2 PAIR - Face Pulls + Lateral Raise
exercises.detail: Face Pulls 70 lb x 15, then straight into Lateral Raise 15 lb x 15. 3 rounds.
exercises.note: Paired, same as Monday - this is the fat-loss adjustment and it saves you about ten minutes. No rest between the two movements. Face pulls at 70 is the home stack, not comparable to the 30 lb you were using at Planet Fitness. Elbows high and wide, pull to the forehead, pause at the back. Lateral raises: lead with the elbow, stop at shoulder height, and do not force the last reps when the shoulders gas out.

exercises.name: BLOCK 2 PAIR - Rope Pushdown + Hammer Curl
exercises.detail: Rope Pushdown 90 lb x 12, then straight into Hammer Curl 30 lb x 10. 3 rounds.
exercises.note: Saturday you ran the pushdown at 90 and dropped to 80 on the last set - fine, do the same if you need it. Hammer curls at 30 gave you 12 then faded to 8 on Sep 12, so the target is a solid 3x10 at 30 before adding. Elbows pinned, no swinging. Drop the third round if the session passes 70 minutes.

exercises.name: BLOCK 3 - Core Circuit
exercises.detail: 2 rounds: Side Plank 45 sec/side, Ab Wheel x 10, Bicycle Kicks x 30
exercises.note: Rotated fresh - not Monday's circuit and not Saturday's. Ab wheel is back in your rotation as of Oct 9; start from the knees and only extend as far as your lower back stays neutral. Side planks: hips stacked, ribs down. Slow and controlled on the bicycles, not a race.
